archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Cairn’s first free DLC launches October 29

entries.headline: Cairn’s first free DLC launches October 29
entries.summary: The Game Bakers’ On the Trail: Deep Water adds three climbing areas and the Water Solo mode, where falling into water avoids injury.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer independently agree on the DLC name, date and core additions.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time uses the earlier opened report’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Paranormal cleaning game Dust till Dawn announced for PC
entries.summary: Mac n Cheese Games’ cleaning simulation is set in a fictional Japanese village, where working later raises both rewards and the risk of paranormal encounters. It is planned for 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer independently confirm the announcement, PC platform and core premise.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time uses the earlier opened report’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga announced for 2027
entries.summary: Taito is bringing the first two Lufia games together in a partially renewed collection for PS5, Switch 2, Switch and PC.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report provides the collection format, platforms and 2027 window; no primary announcement was opened.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from AUTOMATON’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Dream Club ZERO R+ announced for 2027
entries.summary: D3 Publisher announced a port of the 2011 game with three new hostesses. Platforms and the exact meaning of R+ remain unannounced.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the announcement, 2027 window and three added characters.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from AUTOMATON’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Escape from Playtime enters Steam Early Access on October 21
entries.summary: The Poppy Playtime co-op survival-horror spinoff casts players as Smiling Critters escaping the Playtime Co. factory through puzzles, stealth and proximity-chat teamwork.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report states the October 21 Steam Early Access date and the co-op premise.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from IGN’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Really Illegal Golf announced for PC
entries.summary: The stealth-golf game asks players to sneak onto barred courses while evading guards, cameras and drones. It supports solo, online co-op and competitive play and is planned for Q1 2027.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the publisher, developer, PC platform, release window and multiplayer modes.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from AUTOMATON’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: BALL x PIT expansion Risen Ballbylon launches November 6
entries.summary: Devolver Digital and Kenny Sun announced the expansion at $6.99. The opened evidence does not establish the expansion’s platform list.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report confirms the expansion name, November 6 date and $6.99 price.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from Gematsu’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Honkai: Star Rail version 4.6 launches September 28
entries.summary: Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise advances the Astropolis story and adds the five-star Ice Elation character Pearl alongside new events.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report states the developer, version title, September 28 date and key additions.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from Gematsu’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Industrial-noir RPG WANE announced for PC
entries.summary: Shoreline Games and Metis Creative announced a grid-based turn-based RPG in which Declan Wayne leads a three-person party through three biomes. No release date was announced.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report confirms the publisher, developer, PC platform and gameplay loop.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time is converted from Gematsu’s publication timestamp.

entries.headline: Megami Ibunroku Persona soundtrack launches September 21
entries.summary: Atlus announced that the original soundtrack would arrive on music streaming services at midnight Japan time, marking the first game’s 30th anniversary.
entries.verification: Famitsu and Denfaminicogamer independently confirm the soundtrack and launch time; Denfaminicogamer explicitly attributes the announcement to Atlus.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time uses Denfaminicogamer’s timestamp; the launch time itself is midnight Japan time.

entries.headline: Stellar Blade Complete Edition Switch 2 demo launches alongside Bayonetta collaboration details
entries.summary: SHIFT UP launched the Switch 2 demo for Stellar Blade Complete Edition and also revealed four Bayonetta collaboration outfits that will be offered free across Switch 2, PC and PS5.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report relays the TGS 2026 stage and Nintendo eShop information.
entries.timeNote: The source supports a September 20 date and the packet classifies the event inside the fixed window; no exact timestamp is available.

entries.headline: Life-sim MMO Loftia enters Early Access on November 3
entries.summary: Qloud Games announced that Loftia will enter Early Access on November 3, 2026. The life-sim MMO focuses on living across floating islands without combat or competition.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report relays Qloud Games' announcement.
entries.timeNote: The source supports a September 21 announcement date and the packet classifies it inside the fixed window; no exact timestamp is available.

entries.headline: Final Fantasy VII Revelation director says a completionist run can easily exceed 100 hours
entries.summary: Director Naoki Hamaguchi said that checking every asset and element from start to finish can easily push a playthrough beyond 100 hours, while noting that he continues reviewing the latest build even during business trips.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report relays Hamaguchi's comments from a GameSpot interview.
entries.timeNote: IGN's timestamp converts to 04:52 Beijing time on September 21, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Hideo Kojima details Sony's exit from PHYSINT and says he feared for the studio
entries.summary: In an IGN interview, Hideo Kojima said Sony informed him in June that it was ending its PHYSINT involvement and funding. He described concerns about staffing, financing and the studio's future before pitching the project to Xbox.
entries.verification: The opened IGN article is a direct interview with Hideo Kojima.
entries.timeNote: IGN's timestamp converts to 19:00 Beijing time on September 20, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Tokyo Game Show 2026 draws 257,642 visitors across four days as day five is cancelled
entries.summary: CESA reported 257,642 visitors across the four in-person days of Tokyo Game Show 2026. The planned fifth day on September 21 was cancelled because of Typhoon No. 25.
entries.verification: The opened Famitsu report is corroborated by CESA's official September 20 release.
entries.timeNote: CESA published the official release at 21:50 JST on September 20, or 20:50 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse demo launches October 1 with save transfer
entries.summary: Konami, Evil Empire and Motion Twin will release a demo on October 1, with save data transferable to the full game launching October 15 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch and PC.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report relays the publisher and developers' announcement.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu's timestamp converts to 14:35 Beijing time on September 20, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Dynasty Warriors 3: Xtreme Legends Complete Edition Remastered: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered demo launches September 24
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo and Omega Force announced a September 24 demo. The full game launches October 1 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC, with online two-player play planned in a free update by January 2027.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report relays Koei Tecmo and Omega Force's announcement.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu's timestamp converts to 11:30 Beijing time on September 20, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Japan Game Awards 2026 names 10 Future Division winners
entries.summary: CESA announced 10 Future Division winners selected from unreleased works shown or announced at Tokyo Game Show 2026 through public voting and jury review, including Final Fantasy VII Revelation and Persona 4 Revival.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report is corroborated by CESA's official release.
entries.timeNote: CESA published the official release at 16:30 JST on September 20, or 15:30 Beijing time.

checked: Reviewed all 19 bounded same-edition revision candidates and added every story at the user-authorized 'optional but worthwhile' threshold or above that could be safely assigned to the fixed window.
limited: Two PC Gamer candidates lacked sufficient extracted body evidence and were excluded; one Warframe feature was outside the 10:10 cutoff; duplicate candidates were not republished.
sourceReport.note: Same-edition revision preserves issue identity, fixed window and release calendar while adding eight evidence-bounded stories.
